name: MFJS Mirror Cube 3x3 V2 (Magnetic + Ball-Core + UV)
description: The MFJS Mirror Cube 3x3 V2 (Magnetic + Ball-Core + UV) is the ultimate upgrade for shape-mod puzzle enthusiasts. Featuring a ball-core mechanism, this version enhances stability with corner/core magnetization, delivering a more controlled and satisfying turning feel. The UV-coated metallic outer finish not only adds a stunning reflective look but also improves grip for a premium solving experience.
